description: IATI publisher finance, organisation planning, saved refresh and native DQA customer engagements

commandDescriptions.dataset-iati: Retain complete IATI activity and organisation XML, review finance portfolios and planning documents, make precise publisher corrections, review saved refreshes, and deliver or receive the full customer history.
